test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 19 Jul 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined word in the given idiom.

She is an awful bore; she is always blowing her own __saxophone__.
solution:
The correct answer is '**trumpet**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] 

**__Key Points__**

 
• The idiom "**blowing her own saxophone**" means that the person is constantly talking about themselves and their achievements.
 
• The word "**saxophone**" is used metaphorically to represent the person's self-promotion.
